candidate.answerReason: Each classroom has 16 more students than rabbits, so four classrooms have 64 more.

methods.label: Multiply the difference in one classroom
methods.explanation:
Each classroom has \(18-2=16\) more students than rabbits. There are four classrooms, each with this same difference, so altogether there are
\[
4(18-2)=4\cdot16=\boxed{64}
\]
more students than rabbits, choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
methods.levelReason: Only subtraction and multiplication of small whole numbers are needed.

candidate.annotationRationale: The solution combines a within-classroom subtraction with multiplication across four equal groups. Basic subtraction, multiplication meaning, and one-digit multiplication support this mixed arithmetic calculation.
